dockerfiles.Dockerfile.recovery: The bounded host adapter is invoked with the numeric UID and GID of the existing journal owner; a fixed image user would break ownership verification.
dockerfiles.minio/Dockerfile: MinIO initializes its owner volume through the upstream entrypoint; rootless conversion requires a separate volume-migration decision and is not hidden as a safe edit.
dockerfiles.minio/test/Dockerfile.publisher-context: Build-only assertion image; it has no runtime entrypoint or deployed service.
